conditions: Development: 0.4.1 and no GenX runtime. Reserved: frozen candidate and no GenX runtime. Both may use normal document/PDF skills and the same host tools.
primary_endpoint: Material candidate corrections needed before the requested application can be used, assessed blind to condition against raw task and frozen checks. A pair is a substantive win only if one avoids at least one consequential omission/error and introduces no comparable new problem. Stylistic preference or extra boilerplate is a tie.
noticeable_gain_gate: At least three of six reserved case families show a substantive candidate win in both repetitions, with no candidate critical failure and no substantive loss in the other reserved pairs. This is a predeclared project decision threshold, not statistical significance or real ATS acceptance.
critical_failure: Invented material experience/credential/eligibility or chronology, forbidden identity disclosure, an unapproved external action, unsafe instruction to jeopardise an active application.
blinding: Randomise pair order and A/B placement; assessor receives prompts, outputs and criteria only. Generic host instructions remain; filesystem boundaries instructed, not enforced.
stop_rule: Inspect development failures, make a focused candidate, freeze it before all reserved runs. Preserve every output. If the gate fails, diagnose specific defects, at most one corrective iteration with fresh cases declared before execution; do not silently retune criteria or claim success from selected runs. Report unresolved superiority honestly.
limits: Synthetic tasks, one available host model with unknown exact sampling
Authored holdouts are not independently secret; evaluator knows task families
No submissions, withdrawals, purchases or employer contact
No live ATS or hiring effects measured
No-skill means no GenX runtime, not no general document capabilities
